assets.//: Run the Worker only for /api/event; every other request is served by the asset layer (_headers and _redirects still apply) without counting against the account's daily Worker request cap. Markdown content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown -> the page's .md sibling, plus Vary: Accept) is done by Cloudflare zone rules on the balter.com zone (a URL Rewrite Rule and Response Header Transform Rules), not here. worker/routing.test.js guards this list.
